title: Contracts Administrator
description:
Contracts Administrator

Location: Hemel Hempstead
Salary: 13.33 per hour ( 26,436.80 per annum)
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8.00am - 4.30pm
Contract: Temporary to Permanent - 12 weeks temporary with the opportunity to secure a permanent contract.

This role is fully office based in Henel Hempstead.

The Opportunity

Our client, a dynamic and fast-paced organisation, is looking for an organised and customer-focused Contracts Administrator to join their team in Hemel Hempstead.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator who enjoys working in a busy environment, has great attention to detail and takes pride in delivering outstanding customer service.

You will play an important role in supporting the Project Management Team, ensuring contracts are managed efficiently, appointments are coordinated effectively and customer requirements are met to a high standard.

If you are proactive, methodical and confident managing multiple priorities, we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities
- Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Project Management Team.
- Deliver excellent customer service to both internal and external customers.
- Support the management of client accounts, customer requirements and contracts.
- Monitor and maintain individual property requirements.
- Coordinate and schedule surveyor appointments, ensuring surveys are returned and queries resolved.
- Assist with arranging installation appointments and managing schedules.
- Ensure all relevant paperwork is received, checked and accurately recorded.
- Raise purchase orders where required.
- Coordinate property recalls and allocate engineers as necessary.
- Maintain business trackers and provide regular progress updates.
- Assist with monitoring and reporting on KPIs.
- Liaise with clients and customers to ensure their requirements are understood and met.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and customer satisfaction.
- Provide additional operational support as required to meet changing business needs.

Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an administrative or coordination-based role.
- Excellent IT skills, including Microsoft Office and the ability to learn in-house systems.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Good numeracy and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage a varied workload and prioritise effectively.
- A proactive and self-motivated approach, with the ability to use initiative.
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
- The confidence to build and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, clients and external contacts.
- A willingness to learn new skills and adapt to changing business requirements.

What's on Offer?
- 13.33 per hour ( 26,436.80 annual equivalent).
- Monday to Friday working hours - no weekends!
- 12-week temporary assignment with a view to becoming permanent.
- A friendly, supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunities to develop your skills and experience.

Why Temp with Tate?

Temping is a fantastic way to develop your career, gain valuable experience and explore new opportunities. Whether you are looking to bridge the gap between permanent roles, gain experience within a new industry or, as in this case, try out a position before committing to a permanent contract, temping offers flexibility and choice.

Tate Benefits:
- Weekly pay.
- Holiday pay.

Interested? If you have strong administration skills, enjoy coordinating processes and delivering excellent customer service, apply today!

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Customer Service Coordinator - 12 month fixed term contract
description:
Reference: 5206
Customer Service Coordinator

Location: Hemel Hempstead
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm
Contract: 12-month fixed-term contract

The Opportunity

We are recruiting for a Customer Service Coordinator to join an established business based in Hemel Hempstead on a 12-month fixed-term contract to cover maternity leave.

This is a varied, hands-on role combining customer service, scheduling and coordination. You'll act as a key point of contact for customers, managing service requests and coordinating engineers to ensure issues are dealt with efficiently and customers receive a great level of service.

Working closely with internal teams, engineers and external suppliers, you'll help keep day-to-day operations running smoothly, managing schedules, prioritising requests and resolving issues as they arise.

The business uses a bespoke in-house system, and full training will be provided, so you don't need previous experience with the software. What matters most is having the right attitude, strong organisational skills and a genuine passion for customer service.

Key Responsibilities
- Customer Service: Act as the main point of contact for customer enquiries, service requests and complaints, ensuring timely responses and a positive customer experience.
- Scheduling & Coordination: Coordinate engineer diaries and workloads, arranging on-site visits and remote support in line with customer requirements.
- Service Management: Log and monitor service requests, incidents and quality issues, ensuring these are followed through to resolution.
- Problem Solving: Manage changing priorities, investigate issues and know when to escalate more complex cases.
- Maintenance Planning: Schedule routine preventative maintenance visits in line with customer contracts.
- Administration & Reporting: Maintain accurate records, update internal systems and produce reports to identify and resolve recurring issues.
- Supplier Liaison: Communicate with suppliers and third-party providers to support the smooth delivery of services.
- Parts & Deliveries: Provide cover for parts ordering, deliveries and order fulfilment when required.
- Continuous Improvement: Contribute ideas to improve processes, service quality and operational efficiency.

About You

We're looking for an enthusiastic, proactive and hands-on individual who enjoys a varied role and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service.

Ideally, you will have:
- Experience in customer service, customer coordination, scheduling, resource planning or a similar administrative role.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage diaries, coordinate schedules and prioritise competing demands.
- Excellent communication skills and a confident, professional telephone manner.
- Good attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks accurately.
- A practical, solution-focused approach to resolving problems and handling customer queries.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- The confidence to use your own initiative while working collaboratively with colleagues and external contacts.

Previous experience coordinating engineers, field service teams or service appointments would be particularly beneficial.

What's on Offer?
- A varied role combining customer service, scheduling and coordination.
- Full training on the company's bespoke in-house system.
- A supportive team environment.
- Full-time, office-based hours with no weekend working.
- A 12-month fixed-term contract, offering a great opportunity to develop your experience.

Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including: administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing and IT Helpdesk/IT support.

title: Logistics Operations Coordinator
description:
Reference: 5205

Location: Hemel Hempstead
Salary: 30,000+
Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm Fully office based.

The Opportunity
We are recruiting for a Logistics Operations Coordinator to join an established and growing business in Hemel Hempstead.

This is an exciting opportunity to oversee logistics operations across an international network of third-party logistics (3 PL) providers, including warehouse partners across the European Union.

You will play a key role in coordinating stock movements, organising transport and ensuring shipments run smoothly, while supporting trade customers with specific delivery requirements and managing consignment stock arrangements.

This role would suit someone who enjoys building relationships, solving logistical challenges and keeping operations running efficiently across multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities
- 3 PL Management: Oversee outsourced warehouse operations, ensuring providers meet agreed service levels and operational requirements.
- Stock & Inventory: Monitor stock movements and accuracy across multiple locations, investigating and resolving discrepancies with warehouse partners.
- Order & Shipment Coordination: Ensure orders are processed and dispatched on time, coordinating with warehouse partners to meet customer requirements and delivery deadlines.
- Transport Management: Arrange and coordinate transport, ensuring shipments are booked and planned effectively.
- Trade Customer Support: Manage orders for trade customers with specific stock, handling and delivery requirements.
- Consignment Stock: Monitor consignment stock arrangements, maintaining accurate records and ensuring stock availability.
- International Logistics: Coordinate stock movements between international locations and work with partners to resolve delays or other issues.
- Performance & Problem Solving: Monitor 3 PL performance, follow up on service issues and take ownership of resolving shipment and delivery challenges.
- Systems & Reporting: Maintain accurate records and use relevant systems and reports to support stock, order and logistics management. Knowledge of Sage 200 would be advantageous.
- Process Improvement: Identify ways to improve logistics processes, stock visibility and operational efficiency.

About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Experience in logistics, distribution, warehouse operations or supply chain coordination.
- Experience working with 3 PL providers, outsourced warehouses or external distribution partners.
- A good understanding of stock control, order fulfilment, shipment planning and transport coordination.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple locations.
- Excellent communication skills and confidence liaising with customers, warehouse partners, transport providers and internal teams.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving, with strong attention to detail and a focus on customer service.
- Good IT skills and experience using ERP systems; Sage 200 knowledge would be highly desirable.

The Ideal Candidate
You will be comfortable coordinating operations through external partners rather than managing a single warehouse directly. You'll be organised, commercially aware and confident taking ownership of shipments and ensuring customers receive a reliable service.

Interested?
If you have experience in logistics coordination, 3 PL management or distribution operations and are looking for a varied role with international scope, we would love to hear from you.

title: Operations Coordinator
salary_text: £28000 - £29000 per year (Hybrid working, progression and more)
description:
Operations Coordinator - Hemel Hempstead

13.95 per hour + holiday pay Weekly Pay Hybrid Working Temp-to-Perm Opportunity

Are you a customer-focused administrator who enjoys problem-solving, keeping things organised and making sure everything runs smoothly?

Think Specialist Recruitment is working exclusively with a local client in Hemel Hempstead to recruit an Operations Coordinator to join their extremely busy and growing team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an expanding business in a varied role combining customer service, administration, technical support coordination and scheduling. Initially offered on a temporary basis, there is the potential for the position to become permanent for the right person.

You'll be joining a collaborative team where no two days are quite the same, playing an important role in keeping operations running efficiently, supporting field-based engineers and ensuring customer queries are dealt with promptly and professionally.

The best bit? You don't need to come from a technical background. If you have strong customer service and administration experience, enjoy learning new systems and are confident juggling multiple priorities, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

What will you be doing?

You'll act as a key point of contact for technical support queries, coordinating tickets, liaising with engineers and keeping customers and internal teams updated throughout the process.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing support tickets: Raising, updating, prioritising and escalating tickets to ensure issues are dealt with efficiently.
- Coordinating engineers: Allocating tickets to the appropriate departments and field-based engineers across the UK, taking location and requirements into account.
- Supporting customers: Responding to queries, providing accurate updates and managing expectations throughout the resolution process.
- Working with suppliers: Building and maintaining strong working relationships with external vendors.
- Monitoring live issues: Monitoring unit feeds, identifying potential problems and supporting troubleshooting activities.
- Reporting and administration: Maintaining daily reports, updating documentation and ensuring records remain accurate and up to date.
- Keeping operations moving: Working closely with engineers and internal teams to resolve issues, manage priorities and deliver excellent service.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change throughout the day.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in customer service and administration - both are essential.
- Strong IT skills and the ability to pick up new systems and processes quickly.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Good attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- The ability to multitask, prioritise effectively and remain calm under pressure.
- A customer-first mindset and a practical approach to problem-solving.
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to use your own initiative.

Experience that would really make you stand out:
- Working within an operations, service delivery or technical support team.
- Using ticketing or helpdesk systems.
- Coordinating schedules, appointments or field-based engineers.

Don't worry if you haven't worked in every one of these areas before. If you have the right customer service and administrative foundations, a willingness to learn and the ability to keep things organised, we'd love to hear from you.

What's in it for you?
- 13.95 per hour + holiday pay, with weekly pay while temping.
- Equivalent to approximately 29,000 per year on a full-time basis.
- A genuine temporary-to-permanent opportunity.
- Flexible and hybrid working available during the temporary assignment.
- The opportunity to join a growing business with exciting expansion plans.
- Varied responsibilities and the chance to develop new operational and technical skills.

If you move into a permanent position, the additional benefits include:
- Salary of up to 29,000, depending on experience.
- 26 days' annual leave, plus the option to purchase additional days.
- Healthcare plan.
- Enhanced parental leave.
- Volunteering days.
- Opportunities for career progression and further development.

Working hours

The team operates Monday to Friday, with shifts on either:
- 8:30am-5:30pm, or
- 9:00am-6:00pm.

Both shifts include a one-hour lunch break.

The role is based in Hemel Hempstead, with flexible and hybrid working available.

Interested? Let's talk!

If you're looking for a role that offers more variety than a traditional administration position, enjoy helping people and want the opportunity to develop your career within a growing operations team, this could be the perfect fit.

Apply today or contact Think Specialist Recruitment to find out more. We're working exclusively with this client, so we're happy to talk you through the opportunity and what they're looking for.

About Think Specialist Recruitment

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead, supporting businesses and candidates across Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire and Buckinghamshire.

We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment across administration, customer service, HR, accountancy and finance, sales support, marketing and IT support.

title: Purchasing Administrator
description:
We are seeking a Purchasing Administrator to work for a manufacturer of scientific machinery based in Hemel Hempstead.

The purchasing Administrator performs the essential function of monitoring the stock of selected items and ordering and processing of Spares Orders. While liasing with suppliers. The individual will work with engineering and general staff to update and maintain prices for spares and parts. The individual must be flexible, hard-working, the ability to communicate effectively with people on all levels in a friendly and professional manner, show initiative in improving our current systems. Training will be provided.

Key Responsibilities:
- Purcachase goods, materials, components or service in line with specified cost.
- Processing of Spares Orders
- Act as interface between suppliers.
- Monitor and advise on any issues which arise.
- Prepare and raise purchase orders and order schedules
- Build, maintain and manage supplier relationships and keep up good communications.
- Contact suppliers to resolve price, quality, delivery or invoice issues.
- Maintenance of accurate stock levels and control.
- Inspection of goods received.

Essential skills and experience
- Competent in the use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) email and use of the Internet
- Strong administrative skills and well organized
- Proven ability of effective written and verbal communication and listening skills
- Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to effectively communicate
- Commitment to quality
- Ability to work independently or as part of a small team.
- Positive approach to change
- Effective Time Management
- Customer focus
